# The app lists the kernel commands.
$ eidos --help
Usage: eidos <command> [options]

Generates code with the declarative plugins of a workspace.

Commands:
  run         Generates the output of each workspace and commits it.
  plan        Prints the composition of each workspace without running it.
  explain     Prints what the last run recorded about a file, a declaration, a fact or a finding.
  prune       Removes the generated files that no plan produces.
  doctor      Checks the config, the sealed state and the directives of each workspace.
  watch       Runs each workspace again after each change, until an interrupt.
  version     Prints the versions of the binary, of eidos and of the plugins of each workspace.
  schema      Prints the JSON Schema of the config file of the binary.
  completion  Write the completion script of a shell.

Options:
  -C, --chdir string   Run in this directory instead of the working directory.                 env EIDOS_CHDIR
      --config file    Read this config file instead of the one that the search finds.         env EIDOS_CONFIG
      --flag-debug     Print the value and the source of each option before the command runs.  env EIDOS_FLAG_DEBUG
      --format format  Write the output as text or json.                                       default "text", env EIDOS_FORMAT, key format
  -h, --help           Show the help.
      --no-color       Render text without colour.                                             env EIDOS_NO_COLOR, key no-color
      --quiet          Render error findings alone.                                            env EIDOS_QUIET, key quiet
      --strict         Report every warning as an error.                                       env EIDOS_STRICT, key strict
      --verbose        Render info findings.                                                   env EIDOS_VERBOSE, key verbose
[exit 0]

# Each target has a plan. The config file adds the plugin audit to two of them.
$ cat testdata/tree/.eidos.yaml
version: 1
plans:
    golang:
        plugins: [plugins/audit]
    typescript:
        sources: {lang: golang, packages: [./ops]}
        plugins: [plugins/audit]
options:
    audit: {redact: false}
$ eidos --config testdata/tree/.eidos.yaml plan

# The plugin writes a Go implementation, its test, a Go mirror and a TypeScript mirror.
$ cat testdata/tree/.eidos.yaml
version: 1
plans:
    golang:
        plugins: [plugins/audit]
    typescript:
        sources: {lang: golang, packages: [./ops]}
        plugins: [plugins/audit]
options:
    audit: {redact: false}
$ GOMODCACHE=testdata GOROOT=testdata eidos --config testdata/tree/.eidos.yaml run --stdout
// === ops/transfer_audit.go ===
// Code generated by eidos. DO NOT EDIT.
// eidos:plugin audit
// eidos:source ops/transfer.go

package ops

func TransferAudit(from, to string, cents int64) {
	record("Transfer", "warn", from, to, cents)
	Transfer(from, to, cents)
}

// eidos:provenance sha256:6d73624d2444958c35f098dd674d455ea479e1346c491bcdb862488e0299ebda

// === svc/ledger_audit.go ===
// Code generated by eidos. DO NOT EDIT.
// eidos:plugin audit
// eidos:source svc/ledger.go

package svc

type LedgerAudit struct {
	next Ledger
}

// Post adds cents to account, and returns the identifier of the entry.
func (l LedgerAudit) Post(account string, cents int64) string {
	record("Post", "info", account, cents)
	return l.next.Post(account, cents)
}

// eidos:provenance sha256:88162342398065f9351efb9bfc2ba6d2ce06cc94c30177dbf53c15b63f5db8ae

// === svc/ledger_audit_test.go ===
// Code generated by eidos. DO NOT EDIT.
// eidos:plugin audit
// eidos:source svc/ledger.go

package svc

import (
	"testing"
)

// TestLedgerAudit checks that LedgerAudit implements Ledger.
func TestLedgerAudit(t *testing.T) {
	var _ Ledger = LedgerAudit{}
}

// eidos:provenance sha256:adca759b5ba0405f8f4fbe1dfb79bc2f838e2b7d17f49f38d445bbff17bf6eff

// === ops/transfer.audit.ts ===
// Code generated by eidos. DO NOT EDIT.
// eidos:plugin audit
// eidos:source ops/transfer.go

export function transferAudit(from: string, to: string, cents: bigint): void {
  console.warn("Transfer", from, to, cents);
}

// eidos:provenance sha256:11b2eb49b36d8c23fded1f84f14d4660c050ccaa263ea199a56ac8d932a22930

[exit 0]

# A config file that extends no plan writes no file.
$ cat testdata/bare/.eidos.yaml
version: 1
$ GOMODCACHE=testdata GOROOT=testdata eidos --config testdata/bare/.eidos.yaml run --stdout
[exit 0]
